settings: Open & test → Adjust → hall / gallery · recipe controls. Connection controls set passage width and height. In the engine HUD, Living architecture → Find connection ports previews targets, then Connect and align. Detach keeps the current position. Floor reflections are enabled.
limits: Explicit directed ports, not global welding. Entry targets must come from real wall opening exports. The consumer connector is a root typed anchor with input-only pose and dimensions; no nested, context-dependent or repeated from port. Entry/wall fit compares width and height; floor/support fit compares width and depth. The target is not enlarged automatically. Preview checks interfaces and cycles; estimate also checks geometry, roof contact and overrides. Detach before moving a constrained consumer. No automatic obstacle routing or arbitrary mesh Boolean.
prompt: In Polynite, discover architecture connections and the anchor/wall operators. Use an editable assembly recipe: export entrance from the hall wall opening and declare a root entry anchor on the gallery. Inspect both IDs, preview architecture.connections for gallery/from with target hall, then estimate and apply attach:{to:hall,anchor:entrance,from:back000000}. Keep the roof context link and recipes independent. Use compatible doorway dimensions, shared procedural materials and instances. Move/rotate/resize the provider and verify that the thresholds stay aligned and the walls leave a real passage. Preserve overrides; save and reopen the complete scene. Enable soft floor reflections in scene settings.
try: Change the hall Size and Roof rise; the doorway and linked gallery follow.
Under gallery connection controls, adjust Passage width/height within the host doorway. A larger connector is refused without changing the scene.
Save and reopen to retain both independent recipes, the typed connection and materials.
steps: Export a real opening as a typed entry port. Its position, direction and dimensions follow the wall.
Preview compatible ports, then estimate the complete connection before applying it.
Align the thresholds with opposing directions; keep roofs, materials, framing and stairs in recipes.
title: A temple with a way through.
summary: Connect an independent gallery to a real exported doorway. Preview a compatible port, align its threshold and keep both recipes editable.

browser_validation.scope: Integrated Chromium/WebGPU: three compositions with two variants each; direct source edits, typed entry alignment, rejection and full-document restoration in a fresh engine. Native films verify animation separately.
